The '''Vorrnti system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Vorrnti]].<ref name="BM" /><ref name="TERC" />
